register.labelZh: HEAR 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: hear about 和 hear of 可以幫助你回應有關疾病、意外、成功、改動和其他事情的消息。；hear from 表示某人透過訊息、電話、電郵或其他方式聯絡你。；hear of 可以表示你對某個名稱或構思感到熟悉,即使你對它所知不多。；當你希望別人在作出判斷前先聽完整個解釋時,可以使用 hear somebody out。
register.summaryEn: Hear about and hear of help you respond to news about illnesses, accidents, successes, changes and other events. Hear from shows that somebody has contacted you by message, phone, email or another method. Hear of can show that a name or idea is familiar, even when you do not know much about it. Hear somebody out is useful when you want others to listen to your complete explanation before judging you.
contextsZh: 自然談論消息和重要事情

contextsEn: Talk naturally about news and important events
Show the difference between recognition and detailed knowledge

fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。；hear about 和 hear of 都可以表示得知消息。不過,hear of 也可以表示知道某人或某事物存在,即使你對其所知不多。；hear somebody out 表示聽完某人的整個解釋,不要中途打斷或過早作出判斷。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Hear about and hear of can mean receiving news. However, hear of can also mean that you know somebody or something exists, although you may know very little about them. Hear somebody out means listening until the person has finished explaining. Do not interrupt or decide too early.
